agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git ref evidence is supplied only by the machine snapshot rather than duplicated in narrative runtime state.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first runtime-state draft repeated four full Git objects in the git-ref narrative and the preflight rejected it.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The machine preflight returned git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden before planning receipt acceptance.

correction.action: Remove manual object IDs and rely exclusively on the exact preflight snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: The clockwork preflight rejects manually duplicated Git-object evidence before a receipt can pass.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one rejected manual Git-binding draft and successful machine-only correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every active acceptance path in a five-source receipt names an exact existing retained artifact.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first draft used a descriptive architecture operation name rather than the exact retained default-off manifest-secret-posture paths.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Exact repository reads returned path-not-found and a filename inventory identified the accepted retained paths before implementation.

correction.action: Replace all three descriptive paths with the exact retained document, contract and schema paths and regenerate the receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Active acceptance paths are existence-read before the receipt is treated as controlling evidence.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected descriptive-versus-exact acceptance-path binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A capability source guard matches an actual forbidden API token without colliding with accepted field names.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first guard searched for the fragment environ and matched the required environment_identifier field.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The focused test failed on its own overbroad substring while all behavioral cases passed.

correction.action: Match os.environ exactly rather than the ordinary-language fragment.
correction.prevention_control: Source guards use semantic API spellings rather than substrings embedded in accepted identifiers.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected overbroad source-capability guard.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The historical descendant tripwire can verify the exact authorized application diff before the candidate commit.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first form compared only plan-source-to-HEAD committed history and therefore could not see the new staged implementation during precommit verification.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The surrounding test expected the new exact path while its Git command returned only the previously committed normalizer.

correction.action: Compare the plan source directly with the working/index view so exact staged descendants are visible before commit.
correction.prevention_control: Authorized-descendant tripwires use a precommit-visible Git comparison while keeping the path allowlist exact.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one repaired committed-only precommit tripwire blind spot.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every caller-controlled scalar shape returns a closed denial rather than escaping through Python membership behavior.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Direct review found that an unhashable list in a frozenset-backed categorical field could raise before shape denial.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Sol inspected the successful candidate before commit and traced enum membership with hostile non-string values.

correction.action: Require exact string type before every categorical membership and add adversarial list regressions.
correction.prevention_control: Closed categorical validators type-check before set, tuple or equality membership.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected fail-closed unhashable enum edge.
